scope: CSS/source containment and generated markup checks only. No native layout/rendering, geometric overlap, focus, mouse/keyboard or animation measurements.

layout.scope: Generated markup for every screen family/dialog and twenty club identities, plus CSS source containment checks. No browser layout, geometric overlap, pixels, keyboard or smoothness measurements.

layout_markup.scope: Parsed HTML strings from the VM DOM stub; does not validate geometry or visual quality.

two_season.scope: Real cricket engine + new UI dispatch in a VM DOM stub. No browser, visual, geometry, focus or latency certification.

playthrough_markup.scope: Parsed HTML strings from the VM DOM stub; does not validate geometry or visual quality.

reveal.scope: VM clock and command tests; proves reveal sequencing/save guards and unchanged draw order, not rendered smoothness.

highlights.scope: VM actual-score highlights, pacing, pause/modal/title/archive and cold reload; cricket truth unchanged. CSS/markup source protections, no native rendered geometry or smoothness evidence.

cricket_feedback.scope: Source/real-script VM checks of cricket reads, drafting, spectator finals, Super Over ledgers and save rejection. No native browser, visual geometry or smoothness evidence.

dom_tree.scope: DOM tree model checks for keyed identity, replacement, insertion, removal, typing and details state. Does not certify native focus, scroll, geometry or appearance.

changes: Team-room selection stacks below 1100px; XI reads use two columns.
Signing titles, club covers and order cards grow with their content.
Foundation/annual sealed order cards contain inert intrinsic reservations of the revealed card.
Grid/flex children can shrink; names, headings and button labels wrap.
HUD and headings wrap, search labels sit above their controls, and trade columns use zero minimum tracks.
Narrow score panels, stat rows, archive rows and identity groups stack/wrap; dialogs explicitly scroll.
Sealed/revealed order status has identical typography instead of inheriting oversized envelope text.
remaining: All rendered desktop/mobile/zoom overlap checks are outstanding. Intentional layering includes modal dialogs/backdrops, sticky pacing controls, reveal shutters/decorations and the floating feedback toast. Rectangles alone do not prove text collisions.
script_change: Only screens.js changed (order-card reservation markup). Domain, controller, scheduler and save scripts are byte-identical to the final-pass candidate.
